title: TodayWeather for iOS · Reading the current temperature
scenario: The Hourly forecast for a saved place. This iPhone simulator example uses sample weather for Hoehyeon-dong, Seoul.

steps.title: Read a temperature below zero
steps.instruction: Open the Hourly forecast (시간별날씨). Find the current temperature beside the weather icon at the top of the page.
steps.caption: The current temperature in this example is −0.1°, one tenth of a degree below zero.
steps.expected: The decimal point and the following digit appear at 70% of the whole-number size. The minus sign and zero remain full size.
